cards.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one square picture for one matching pair in a hard panda memory-card deck.
Primary request: Exactly ONE extremely cute cartoon giant panda, full body, seated upright facing the viewer, both round feet planted apart in front, BOTH forepaws resting low on its knees, head upright, both eyes open and a tiny closed-mouth smile.
Character and style: a consistent chubby baby giant panda with a large round head, small round black ears, classic black oval eye patches, small black dot eyes with single white highlights, tiny black nose, creamy white face and round belly, black arms and legs, subtle pale pink cheek blush. Charming clean 2D children's cartoon, bold smooth charcoal outlines, simple softly shaded flat shapes, very restrained rounded highlights; no realistic fur, no sketchy texture, no 3D.
Scene/backdrop: completely plain warm ivory cream background #FAF5EA, with only a tiny soft pale gray-beige grounding shadow.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, ideally 1024x1024 PNG. Large centered single character, entire ears, paws and body visible. Keep every part within a 12 percent safe margin. Character occupies about 70 to 75 percent of canvas height. Front view at eye level, consistent scale.
The deck is intentionally challenging: black and white panda anatomy and background stay consistent across every card; only pose, head angle, and facial expression change. This is the neutral seated anchor image.
No bamboo, food, clothes, accessories, scenery, colored props, text, numbers, letters, logos, borders, frames, watermarks, extra pandas, inset images or collage. Exactly four limbs with anatomically readable paws.
